assets.prompt:
Use case: game UI art. Create ONE playing-card FRONT FRAME for a cute cat fantasy board game. EXACT output canvas 750×1050 pixels PNG (5:7), upright, no tilt or perspective, full card fills the canvas without outer padding. Reference 1 defines the clean angular flat illustration style; reference 2 is the card BACK and defines only the outer silhouette and clipped inner corners (do NOT draw its central diamond); reference 3 is a technical layout guide, use ONLY its two solid panel outlines and outer shape. Never copy any lettering, red dashed line, symbols or labels from the guide.
Same outer silhouette as the attached card back: rounded outer corners radius about 40 px, transparency ONLY outside those rounded corners, every pixel inside the card fully opaque. A darker brown-gold outer border band about 14 px, NOT a black outline; inner face warm yellow #E7B23A, with inner corners cut diagonally like the gold line on the card back. Flat illustration, not a photographed or 3D card.
Precisely follow these coordinates on the 750×1050 canvas: upper illustration window outer rectangle x36 y126 width678 height398, with a 7 px dark gold #96661A border and corner radius about12px, interior one solid pale warm yellow #FFF1CC. Lower description panel outer rectangle x36 y584 width678 height430, 7px dark gold border and rounded corners about12px, interior one uniform solid parchment #FBF6E8. These two panels are the ONLY inset panels.
The name area at the top, cost area top-left, dice area top-right, type line between the two panels, and all of the description panel including its bottom stat area MUST stay entirely empty. Do NOT draw frames, badges, circles, notches, dividers, dashed lines or icons for those code-supplied fields. The illustration window is wholly empty and opaque, no artwork or character. The whole description panel is wholly empty and opaque, no ornament or divider.
Small flat faceted gem-cut planes in 2–3 tones are allowed ONLY along the outer border band and the narrow empty perimeter outside the field positions. Keep the large top name strip, gap between panels and both panel interiors as absolutely uniform flat colors. Restrained sharp corner facet accents, broad clean geometry; no texture or shading inside plain surfaces. No text, letters, numbers, icons, symbols, paw prints, gems, diamonds, watermark or signature anywhere. No external shadow. Light source upper left.
Clean indie flat vector illustration matching the style reference warrior exactly: angular faceted planes with straight hard edges, like folded paper or cut gems, two to four tones per material, single light source from the upper left. Bold dramatic silhouette, same body proportions and exaggeration as the reference. No rounded blobby shapes, no gradients, no texture, no grain, no noise, no glow, no blur, no black outlines. Crisp clean edges, transparent only outside the rounded corners. Simple eyes like the reference with one clear white highlight at the upper left. Smallest details at least 10 px wide.
